text: REQ-310 (2026-02-02, Platform, limits): The upload API accepts files up to 25 MB.
REQ-322 (2026-02-19, Platform, limits): A client may run at most 4 downloads at the same time.

REQ-341 (2026-05-02, Platform, limits): The maximum size of a single file in the download API has not been decided; it waits for the capacity review. The upload limit in REQ-310 must not be assumed to apply to downloads.
